_comment: A deliberately broken screen, so `layout_audit.py` can be shown to still find things. A sweep that reports zero defects is only worth reading if the thing reporting it can fail — and this analyzer drops a lot on purpose (containment, same-label pairs, keyboard furniture, scrolled-away content), any one of which could be widened until nothing survives. Run `python3 tools/layout_audit.py tools/layout_selftest` and expect exactly two findings: one overlap of 840, one offscreen-x.
